key_insight: The paper argues that PQC and QKD are complementary quantum-safe approaches and proposes a unified taxonomy to compare hybrid designs that remain secure if either component holds.
engineering_relevance: It helps engineers choose and evaluate deployable quantum-safe key exchange architectures for TLS, IKEv2, MACsec, and QKD-backed systems under realistic trust and standards constraints.
method: Defined an 8-dimension taxonomy for hybrid PQC-QKD designs
Compared published protocols, RFC-standardized mechanisms, and key-combiner constructions against common security-model criteria
Synthesized deployment, standards, and policy evidence from testbeds and national guidance
evidence_signal: The abstract reports a literature-based comparative synthesis spanning deployed QKD networks, RFCs 8784/9370/9867, and standards guidance rather than new experimental results.
watch_item: A major implementation concern is authenticating the QKD classical channel and proving security when shared infrastructure, imperfect devices, or partially compromised components are involved.
paper_title: Combining Post-Quantum Cryptography and Quantum Key Distribution: Taxonomy, Constructions, Proofs, Standards, Deployments and Open Problems
